US Lawmaker Seeks Impeachment of Defense Secretary Hegseth

Republican Representative Thomas Massie has initiated an impeachment effort against U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. Massie introduced eight articles of impeachment, citing Hegseth's actions related to the Iran war. The move aims to force a vote on the impeachment articles. Todd Blanche, representing Hegseth, has defended him against the accusations.
